observations: Single-head computerized embroidery machine, industrial type, mounted on a table.
Multiple thread spools (red, green, purple, white) loaded on spool stands.
Control panel on the right with a lit screen showing a graphic/menu, and a green indicator light suggesting the unit is powered.
Ten to twelve needle bars visible on the head.
Cursive brand text resembling 'Yinghe' visible in blue on the machine housing, lower center of the head.
A rectangular hooping frame (green/white) is attached below the needle plate.
No serial number plate, no power cable, no control box, and no stitched sample fabric visible in the single photo.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'TOBI' overlaid on the image.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 only shows the machine powered on with screen lit; no stitching sample or maintenance records are visible.
Photo 0 shows partial cursive text that reads closer to 'Yinghe'; exact spelling not fully legible.

risks.risk: Machine may not actually stitch correctly despite screen being lit (motor, needle timing, hook, or control board faults are common in used units).
risks.proof: A short video clip of the machine running a test embroidery pattern on fabric.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / needs repair

risks.risk: Missing accessories such as power cable, foot pedal, USB/software dongle, or additional hoops that affect usability.
risks.proof: Photo of the full accessory set laid out beside the machine.
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare unit only, accessories not included

risks.risk: Unknown age, true model number, and number of needles/heads (affects value significantly between single vs multi-head models).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the nameplate/serial sticker, usually on the side or back of the machine.
risks.if_unproven: priced at base single-head configuration as visually counted

risks.risk: Control panel screen may show a static/demo image rather than a live, functioning interface.
risks.proof: Video showing the screen responding to button presses and menu navigation.
risks.if_unproven: priced as control panel unverified/possibly faulty

proof_requests: Video of the machine actively embroidering a design on fabric.
Close-up photo of the nameplate/serial number and brand logo.
Photo of all included accessories (power cable, pedal, hoops, software/dongle).
Additional photos from other angles (back, side, underside) to check for wear, rust, or missing parts.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a used single-head computerized embroidery machine with a visible brand marking, but no functional proof (stitching demo) or accessory/nameplate detail is shown, so it must be priced at worst case pending further proof.
